items.title: Painter Hotline Extends 25% Off Painting Labor to Nov. 15
items.summary: Painter Hotline extended 25% off labor to projects booked by Nov. 15, 2026, and lets every customer choose a free photo estimate or an in-person walkthrough.
items.content_text: Painter Hotline, the Colorado painting company at [painterhotline.com](https://painterhotline.com/), has extended its fall offer. Painting projects booked by Nov. 15, 2026, now receive 25% off labor. The discount covers labor only; paint and materials are not included. The offer had previously been advertised through Oct. 31. Along with the extension, every estimate request on the company's site now asks the customer to choose how the estimate is done. A virtual estimate needs four questions answered and a few photos uploaded, and the written number usually comes back within one business day, with no appointment. Customers who would rather have someone look at the job can pick an in-person walkthrough instead. Both options are free. The offer covers the work of the company's separate crews: interiors, exteriors, kitchen cabinet refinishing, commercial painting, deck and fence staining, and specialty coatings. Painter Hotline works across the Denver metro and Colorado's Front Range, from Castle Rock to Longmont and from Fort Morgan to Breckenridge. > Projects booked by November 15 get 25% off labor.
